changelog: SMOOTH AGAIN, AND PIECES YOU CAN SEE. Moving a unit now shows the piece for its whole trip instead of having it vanish and reappear at the target — the tiles were clipping the travelling piece to a square it had already left. Panning and pinch-zooming are back on the graphics card rather than the main thread, which is what caused the horizontal tearing; frame time on a large map dropped from 24.3ms to 8.3ms, and the board no longer paints the wood under solid fog. TILES EXPLAIN THEMSELVES. Tapping the objective now describes the objective instead of the ground it stands on, the calm eye of a storm identifies itself, and a command node draws its art in the detail panel instead of a blank square — a draw node also stops advertising the wrong reward. The inspect panel no longer prints the engine's internal tag list, and the decorative symbols are out of the text.
